title: Dhurandhar Deewaniyat
prompt: Modern Bollywood commercial film track, aggressive electronic synth bass with heavy 808 sub drops, punchy urban dholak and Punjabi hip-hop hybrid dance beats, high-energy rhythm section mixed with cinematic orchestral strings and acoustic guitar strums, explosive and catchy melodic hooks, featuring powerful female Punjabi vocals and soulful, expressive male playback singing with crisp modern pop audio production, maximum volume density
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Upbeat electronic synth melody building up with a heavy dhol loop)

[Verse 1]
[Male Vocals]
(Soulful, expressive playback style like Arijit Singh)
Teri raahon mein khoya rahoon,
Dil ki baatein main tujhse kahoon.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Duet]
(Cinematic strings swell, building intense energy and rhythm)
Waqt ki dhool mein khona nahi,
Ab toh humein juda hona nahi.

[Chorus]
[Drop, Explosive full commercial arrangement]
[Female Vocals]
(High-energy, punchy vocals like Jasmine Sandlas, heavy bass drops)
Mera dil vi tu, meri jaan vi tu,
Ab jeena hai tere bin kyun!
Mera dil vi tu, meri jaan vi tu,
Ab jeena hai tere bin kyun!

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocals]
(Sassy, energetic Punjabi delivery over modern hip-hop groove)
Aankhon mein teri hai naya asar,
Hum chal pade hain udhar jidhar.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Duet]
(Cinematic strings swell, building intense energy and rhythm)
Waqt ki dhool mein khona nahi,
Ab toh humein juda hona nahi.

[Chorus]
[Drop, Explosive full commercial arrangement]
[Female Vocals]
(High-energy, punchy vocals like Jasmine Sandlas, heavy bass drops)
Mera dil vi tu, meri jaan vi tu,
Ab jeena hai tere bin kyun!

[Bridge]
[Dhol and Guitar Solo]
(Massive breakdown with traditional dhol beats and modern synth leads)
Tum mere na huye toh kya,
Khwaab toh dekhoon sanam.

[Outro]
[High Energy]
(Fading electronic beat mixed with energetic vocal chants)
Mera dil vi tu, meri jaan vi tu...
Ab jeena hai tere bin kyun! (Fade out)
